"""Two windows inside a nested compositor: does A.present() bring A to the front while B has focus?"""
import os, subprocess, sys, time
import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk, GLib

MODE = sys.argv[1]            # idle | typing
HOST_DISPLAY = os.environ['HOST_DISPLAY']

def windows():
    out = subprocess.run(['gdbus', 'call', '--session', '--dest', 'org.pantheon.gala', '--object-path', '/org/pantheon/gala/DesktopInterface',
                          '--method', 'org.pantheon.gala.DesktopIntegration.GetWindows'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return out.split('), (')

def focused_title():
    for w in windows():
        if "'has-focus': <true>" in w:
            for title in ('probe-A', 'probe-B'):
                if "'%s'" % title in w:
                    return title
    return 'none'

class App(Gtk.Application):
    def do_activate(self):
        self.a = Gtk.ApplicationWindow(application=self, title='probe-A', default_width=320, default_height=160)
        self.a.set_child(Gtk.Label(label='A'))
        self.a.present()
        GLib.timeout_add(1200, self.open_b)

    def open_b(self):
        self.b = Gtk.ApplicationWindow(application=self, title='probe-B', default_width=320, default_height=160)
        self.b.set_child(Gtk.Label(label='B'))
        self.b.present()
        GLib.timeout_add(1500, self.begin)
        return False

    def begin(self):
        print('setup: focus is on', focused_title(), flush=True)
        self.typing = None
        if MODE == 'typing':
            subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'mousemove', '600', '400'], env=dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=HOST_DISPLAY))
            # ~2.4 s of steady typing into the nested compositor window
            self.typing = subprocess.Popen(['xdotool', 'key', '--delay', '120'] + ['a'] * 20, env=dict(os.environ, DISPLAY=HOST_DISPLAY))
            self.typing_started = time.monotonic()
            GLib.timeout_add(500, self.call_present)
        else:
            self.call_present()
        return False

    def call_present(self):
        self.t_present = time.monotonic()
        self.a.present()
        GLib.timeout_add(100, self.poll)
        return False

    def poll(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        who = focused_title()
        if who == 'probe-A':
            typed = ''
            if self.typing is not None:
                typed = ' | typing %s' % ('still running' if self.typing.poll() is None else 'already finished')
            print('RESULT focused=A after %.0f ms%s' % ((now - self.t_present) * 1000, typed), flush=True)
            self.quit(); return False
        if now - self.t_present > 7:
            print('RESULT focused=%s (A never raised in 7s)' % who, flush=True)
            self.quit(); return False
        return True

App(application_id='ms.nested.probe').run([])
PYEOF
cat > $S/nested_run.sh <<'SHEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: nested_run.sh MODE POLICY   (MODE: idle|typing, POLICY: raise|strict)
set -u
S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-sdolbec-Projects/252beba7-e316-4ce5-a325-7e538495f44e/scratchpad
export MODE=$1 POLICY=$2 S
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x800x24" dbus-run-session -- bash -c '
  export HOST_DISPLAY=$DISPLAY
  rt=$(mktemp -d); chmod 700 $rt; export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$rt
  PANTHEON_ACTIVATION_POLICY=$POLICY $S/ctarget/debug/pantheon-compositor --backend nested >$S/nested-$MODE-$POLICY.log 2>&1 &
  comp=$!
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do sock=$(ls $rt | grep "^wayland-[0-9]*$" | head -1); [ -n "$sock" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done
  [ -z "$sock" ] && { echo "compositor socket never appeared"; tail -5 $S/nested-$MODE-$POLICY.log; kill $comp; exit 3; }
  sleep 1
  env -u DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY=$sock GDK_BACKEND=wayland GSK_RENDERER=cairo timeout 40 python3 -W ignore $S/nested_probe.py $MODE 2>&1 | grep -E "^(setup|RESULT)"
  kill $comp 2>/dev/null; wait $comp 2>/dev/null; rm -rf $rt'
SHEOF
chmod +x $S/nested_run.sh; echo "=== BEFORE-behaviour: strict policy, idle ==="; timeout 120 $S/nested_run.sh idle strict 2>&1 | tail -4
[/external_agent_tool_call]
